OverviewFeaturesUse casesPricingTradeoffsCompatibilityFAQ

What is Grok?

Conversational assistant from xAI with a deliberately less filtered personality and live grounding in the X (Twitter) firehose. Positioned as a real-time-aware chatbot with image generation and voice.

Best for

Real-time awareness of what is being said on X right now.

Main features

  • Real-time X/web data access
  • DeepSearch and DeeperSearch research modes
  • Think mode for step-by-step reasoning
  • Aurora/Grok Imagine image and video generation
  • voice mode
  • Companions
  • multiple personality modes.

Practical use cases

  • Tracking breaking news and social sentiment in real time
  • informal research
  • image generation
  • casual conversation
  • coding help
  • summarising X threads.

Who is it for?

  • X users, consumers who want real-time social-media awareness, developers, and users who dislike heavy content filtering.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium; bundled with X Premium tiers; separate API

Plans described in the source

Free tier with rate limits. SuperGrok around $30/mo. SuperGrok Heavy around $300/mo for the highest limits and earliest model access. Also bundled into X Premium+ (price varies by region and has changed repeatedly). xAI API billed per token, separate.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with meaningful rate limits, accessible on grok.com and in the X app.

Free trial

Occasional promotional free periods; no standing trial.

Usage limits to consider

Free tier has tight query and image-generation caps that reset on a rolling window. DeepSearch and Think modes have separate, lower caps.

Confirm current plans and pricing ↗

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Genuinely real-time social data no competitor matches
  • fast
  • permissive content policy suits some creative and research work
  • image generation included at low tiers.

Limitations to consider

  • Pricing and plan names have changed frequently and are poorly documented
  • less filtered output is a compliance risk in corporate settings
  • enterprise governance features are immature
  • accuracy on X-sourced claims depends on the quality of the underlying posts.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android, integrated in the X app

Languages

  • Multilingual, strongest in English; Arabic and French supported but less polished

API access

Yes - xAI API, token-metered, OpenAI-compatible endpoints

Integrations and exports

  • X platform native
  • Tesla vehicles
  • Azure AI Foundry
  • third-party via API

Evaluation notes

Verify current tier names and prices directly - Grok's plan structure has been among the least stable in the market. Not recommended as a system of record for regulated industries.
